userdoc.notice: This contract streams a fixed amount of USDC to a receiver over a specified duration. The contract uses Chainlink oracles to determine the amount of COMP tokens needed to cover the owed amount in USD. The contract allows the receiver to claim the owed amount of COMP tokens and also allows for the remaining balance to be swept after the stream has ended.
